exposure: cervical dilation during labor preceding the first cesarean
women with a cesarean due to dystocia
cohort: 3116 women with a first cesarean undergoing a trial of labor with a singleton infant in cephalic presentation at ≥37 weeks of gestation
finding: Women with a first unplanned cesarean had a higher risk of repeat cesarean compared with women with an elective first cesarean.
mod_finding: Greater cervical dilation in the first delivery ending with a cesarean was associated with an increased chance of vaginal birth in the subsequent delivery.
